HEADER: CE Large Outsider (Boss, Demon, Extraplanar, Ice, Primal)
DEFENSE: AC 25, touch 14; flat-footed 20 (-1 size, +5 dex, +11 natural)
Immune ice, blind, curse, death effects, disease, frog, mind-affecting, mini, petrification, poison, sap, silence, sleep;
OFFENSE: Melee +2 Frost Trident +25/+20/+15/+10 (2d6+7 plus 1d6 ice damage)
Special Attack Black Ice, Fimbulwinter, Frostwave
Spells Known (FC CL 14th, Concentration +23) [+2 DC on Ice spells]
2nd (DC 21) - Blizzard II, Elemental Weapon, Frigid Touch, Frost Fall, Icy Breath, Slick II
3rd (DC 22) - Blizzara, Blizzard III, Dispel, Slick III
4th (DC 23) - Blizzard IV, Ice Spikes, Ice Storm, Wall of Ice
5th (DC 24) - Blizzaga, Cone of Cold, Freeze, Slow
STATISTICS: Str 20, Dex 20, Con 22, Int 18, Wis 29, Cha 26
Feats Combat Reflexes, Elemental Focus (Ice), Greater Elemental Focus (Ice), Vital Strike, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Trident), Chain Spell

Skills Bluff +32, Intimidate +32, Knowledge (geography) +25, Knowledge (history) +25, Knowledge (nature) +25, Knowledge (planes) +28, Knowledge (religion) +28, Spellcraft +33, Swim +26, Use Magic Device +32
SQ Does not Eat, Does not Sleep
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Flash Freeze (su) This Burst Mode lets the air grows cold around Mateus, as a strong hail storm rolls in. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Mateus adds an additional dice to his Ice spells, and an additional 1d6 points of ice damage per weapon attack, and every physical attack inflicts frozen for 1d4 rounds (Fort DC 28 negates). This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

Frostwave (su) Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, Mateus uses water to freeze into a column of solid ice that bursts. All creatures in a 50-ft.-line that is 30-ft.-wide take 12d6 points of Ice damage and are inflicted with the frozen status effect for 2d6 rounds unless they make a successful Reflex save (DC 28) for half the damage and negating the status effect. Blue Mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC26).

Black Ice (su) As a swift action, Mateus unleashes a chilling wind from his trident in a 30 ft.-cone that deals 4d6 points of ice damage and freezes the ground below them for 2d4 rounds that causes the ground to become a slippery surface. Blue Mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 24).

Fimbulwinter (ex) As a swift action, Mateus unleashes a hail storm in a 200 ft.- radius around himself for 10 rounds. The hailstorm deals 5d6 ice damage every turn and a successful Reflex save (DC 25) halves the damage on each instance of damage.

curation.summary: Mateus, the Corrupt is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 42 generated item(s) across 7 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
